description: STACKED LIFLayer spiking actor with a WIDER SECOND hidden layer (obs -> 32 LIF -> 64 LIF -> act_dim) + exp19-style MLP exponential-head critic. RESCALER RECIPE: hidden LIFLayers use output_transform='rescale' (INPUT-INDEPENDENT learnable per-channel affine, no per-sample distortion), the FINAL readout layer uses output_transform='log', then a learnable per-action affine decode (out_center=2.75) -> ~zero-centred initial action mean. DEFAULT gain everywhere; hidden rescalers init-calibrated per in_dim from measured raw spike-time stats (17->(12.4,1.0), 32->(15.6,2.9)). Whole actor path @torch.compile. Critic = exp20/exp19's exact exp-MLP head (fastlut_lse_sum_expmlpcrit critic head, tau_c init 0.25). PPO bench7 recipe. Sibling of the exp21 variants (32-32 and 192-32 first-layer widths); this widens the SECOND hidden layer 32->64.
actor: stacked LIFLayer 17->32(rescale)->64(rescale)->6(log), default gain, @torch.compile; learnable log-time->action affine (out_center=2.75)
critic: exp19-style MLP exponential head ([256,256] Tanh, centred sum-scaled LSE readout, tau_c init 0.25)
